messages.content: Do you ever regret saying something too directly?
Occasionally, if the timing was off rather than the content. I don't usually regret being honest, just sometimes wish I'd waited five minutes.
how do you know when to wait vs just say it
If the other person's clearly upset already, I'll wait. If it's just a normal conversation, I don't see the point in sitting on something.
